parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table configured on the network instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that determines the start point of the query. Valid values:

*   If this is your first query and no subsequent queries are to be sent, ignore this parameter.
*   If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call.

parameters.name: RouteFilter
parameters.description: The filter condition for the destination CIDR block.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description: Specifies whether to host the route. If you leave the parameter empty, the route is not hosted. A value of TR specifies that the route is hosted on a transit router.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance connection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn list-cen-child-instance-route-entries-to-attachment --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --cen-id cen-dc4vwznpwbobrl0000 --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje79u1g4t0000 --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-r6g0m3epjehw570000 --route-filter '[{"Value":["10.0.0.0/8"],"Key":"prefix-exact-match"}]' --service-type TR --region cn-hangzhou
